description: This PHP class BufferStream implements the PSR-7 StreamInterface, providing a buffer stream that can be written to and read from. It manages an internal buffer and a high water mark to control buffer size, supporting typical stream operations such as read, write, close, and getContents.

classes.name: BufferStream
classes.description: Final class implementing a buffer stream with write/read capabilities and a configurable high water mark. Uses an internal string buffer to manage data and provides methods to interact with the stream's state.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes BufferStream with an optional high water mark value (default 16384).

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the contents of the buffer and clears it.

methods.name: getContents
methods.description: Returns the buffer content and resets the buffer to an empty string.

methods.name: detach
methods.description: Closes the buffer and returns null.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the length of the current buffer.

methods.name: isReadable
methods.description: Always returns true, indicating the buffer is readable.

methods.name: isWritable
methods.description: Always returns true, indicating the buffer is writable.

methods.name: isSeekable
methods.description: Always returns false, indicating the buffer cannot be seeked.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Resets the reading position to the beginning, implemented by calling seek(0).

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Throws RuntimeException as seeking is not supported.

methods.name: eof
methods.description: Returns true if the buffer is empty, indicating end of stream.

methods.name: tell
methods.description: Throws RuntimeException as it cannot determine the current position.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads a specified number of bytes from the buffer, removing them from the buffer.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Appends data to the buffer and returns 0 if the high water mark is exceeded, otherwise returns the length of the written string.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Returns the high water mark if requested, otherwise returns an empty array or null.
